text:
Aisha: Router placement show-and-tell! I'm debating balcony vs bookshelf vs ceiling. Moving my setup this weekend, curious what actually works. Pics encouraged.
Ben: Balcony seems cool but waterproofing is a nightmare. Rain + metal railing = weird reflections.
Leah: Bookshelf behind the TV here, terrible idea. TV is a Faraday cage. :grimacing:
Carlos: Ceiling hook + short PoE AP = best coverage in my old apartment. Looks weird but 0 dead zones.
Aisha: Poll: 1) Desk 2) Bookshelf 3) Balcony/window 4) Ceiling/above desk 5) Other. Reply number to vote.
Ben: 3 (balcony) but with a canopy :umbrella:
Leah: 2. TV = signal black hole 
Carlos: 4 here. Mounted AP + cable tidy.
Nora (homebot): Quick tip: if you're on Linux, run `sudo iw dev wlan0 scan | grep SSID` to check neighbors before picking channel. Internal guide: https://redwood.internal/networking/wfh
Aisha: Anyone used directional antennas? Thinking of a little patch antenna pointed at the desk.
Ben: Directional helped my cafe setup but for home it made signal worse in side rooms.
Leah: Velcro + short Ethernet extension saved me. Router off the floor + elevated = immediate improvement.
Carlos: Powerline adapters worked once for ~6 months then flaky after neighbor replaced a breaker. YMMV.
Aisha: Vote tally: 1 x balcony, 1 x bookshelf, 1 x ceiling. Anyone else?
Leah: 1 (desk) later. I moved it to the shelf above my monitor, looks tidy.
Ben: Also avoid putting router next to big mirrors or fish tanks, for whatever reason my aquarium messed it up :fish:
Carlos: For nerds: enable 5GHz band and pick a channel in the upper range to avoid most interference. Use a Wi-Fi analyzer on your phone.
Aisha: Thanks all 10 I'll try ceiling mount + extension cable. Will post before/after pics. Meme caption idea: "Router: I just wanted a window seat." :seat:
Ben: Please deliver pics 642"
